topic: Palette ownership, area roles, material/pattern colours, receiving geometry, spatial cast transition and grading separation

chosen_concept.place: a small seaside observatory storm entrance
chosen_concept.current_event: aligning a narrow floor strip along the open doorway
chosen_concept.lighting_transition: warm white desk light in the near room and blue daylight in the room beyond

expectations.expected_relation: Warm source illuminates near-facing stone, face and sleeve; blue window light cools far floor, opposite jamb face and hair rim.
expectations.confusion_alternative: A decorative warm/blue split with no corresponding sources or receiving-face logic.
expectations.native_pixel_pass_criterion: Both visible sources and at least three consistent receiving faces are assessable; contradictory cast placement fails.

expectations.expected_relation: One recognizably continuous neutral limestone floor changes apparent colour as it passes through the open threshold.
expectations.confusion_alternative: Two differently painted floor sections or disconnected swatches.
expectations.native_pixel_pass_criterion: Continuous floor texture/form crosses boundary and cast changes with room exposure; partial or invisible continuity fails.

expectations.expected_relation: Ivory/charcoal knit, gray stone/plaster and two brick-red object surfaces retain their respective intrinsic identity.
expectations.confusion_alternative: Blue-painted costume/walls or red glow substituted for red surfaces.
expectations.native_pixel_pass_criterion: Identify each carrier and source-dependent cast separately; a missing or misassigned carrier fails.

expectations.expected_relation: Neutral architecture/floor dominates, ivory garment is secondary, red tab/toolbox remain small accents.
expectations.confusion_alternative: Equal vivid colour blocks or a red room replacing the small red objects.
expectations.native_pixel_pass_criterion: The neutral field is visibly largest and the red pair stays compact; any role inversion fails.

expectations.expected_relation: Matte charcoal apron, ribbed ivory/charcoal knit, painted steel toolbox, woven red tab and satin latch show distinct behaviours.
expectations.confusion_alternative: Global colour haze, glossy apron, stripes caused by cast light, or generic flat surfaces.
expectations.native_pixel_pass_criterion: Fabric stripes follow cloth and materials have differentiated texture/reflection; absent material distinction fails.

expectations.expected_relation: Restrained rendering preserves local casts and midtone detail.
expectations.confusion_alternative: A full-frame warm or blue grade used as the source effect.
expectations.native_pixel_pass_criterion: Both source regions remain locally different with plausible neutral shadows; a uniform stylized grade fails.

expectations.expected_relation: Visible facial proportions and short dark bob with wispy fringe are recognizable as appearance guidance.
expectations.confusion_alternative: Unrelated face/hair, or biography/character inference claimed from reference.
expectations.native_pixel_pass_criterion: Visual resemblance assessed only from face/hair at the rendered angle; metadata never establishes actual identity.

expectations.expected_relation: One worker seats a weather strip while outer moisture explains the practical need.
expectations.confusion_alternative: A fashion pose with unexplained touching or separate unrelated demonstrations.
expectations.native_pixel_pass_criterion: Hand-strip contact and open threshold are legible with environmental rain traces; ambiguity is recorded as failure.

comparison_baseline: none; no improvement claim is permitted
notes: The research criteria and fictional scene are agent-created testing choices. They do not expand requester text, definitions, anchors or acceptance.
